create_HubertFeatureReader: create a HubertFeatureReader instance from a HuBERT checkpoint path to extract audio features
run_get_features: run get_features on a HuBERT reader to extract features from a 1D audio waveform tensor
run_load_checkpoint: run load_checkpoint_ to load a fairseq HuBERT model ensemble and task from a checkpoint file
review_HubertFeatureReader_forward: review the HubertFeatureReader forward method that handles lazy loading and delegates to get_features
test_HubertFeatureReader_init: test the HubertFeatureReader constructor with parameters for layer, feat_hop_size, max_chunk, and lazy_load
